source_doc: Genuin x iHeart - Monetize O&O, Audience Extension Framework

entities.name: iHeart
entities.description: Established brand partner on the Genuin Network. Owns Triton TAP (its SSP) and the targeting decisioning across direct and programmatic execution in this integration.

entities.name: PMC
entities.description: Publisher domain (pmc.com) onboarded into iHeart's extended network using Genuin-generated Web SDK tags under Option A.

entities.name: MCC
entities.description: Example publisher in Genuin's existing brand network used under Option B (Offsite Audience Extension).

entities.name: TED
entities.description: Example publisher in Genuin's existing brand network used under Option B (Offsite Audience Extension).

entities.name: LiveRamp
entities.description: Enterprise-grade third-party identity provider with deep integrations across publisher and advertiser ecosystems; preferred for programmatic audio identity resolution.

entities.name: ID5
entities.description: Open, privacy-first identity solution with strong cookieless reach and wide DSP integration, listed as a third-party identity partner option.

entities.name: Lotame
entities.description: Identity provider specialising in data collaboration with flexible matching for mid-market platforms.

entities.name: UID 2.0
entities.description: Privacy-preserving universal ID — email-based pseudonymous identifier with growing publisher adoption — operated by The Trade Desk.

entities.name: The Trade Desk
entities.description: Operator of UID 2.0, the universal pseudonymous identifier referenced as a third-party identity option.

entities.name: Triton TAP
entities.description: iHeart-owned SSP that receives ad requests from Genuin SDK, packages signals into oRTB 2.x bid requests, runs the programmatic auction, and returns VAST audio creatives.

entities.name: Beeswax
entities.description: DSP / demand platform that applies its own targeting model on oRTB bid requests from Triton TAP and selects the winning audio creative.

entities.name: oRTB 2.x
entities.description: OpenRTB 2.x bid-request protocol used by Triton TAP to package contextual and device signals when sending demand requests to Beeswax.

entities.name: VAST
entities.description: Video Ad Serving Template format used to return the winning audio creative (with impression and click trackers) from Triton TAP back to Genuin SDK.

entities.name: Ads.txt
entities.description: Publisher authorisation file whose entries iHeart manages for newly onboarded publisher domains under Option A.

entities.name: Sellers.json
entities.description: Supply-chain transparency file whose entries iHeart manages for new publisher domains under Option A.

entities.name: BYOA
entities.description: Direct-sponsorship targeting mode in which iHeart's proprietary algorithm replaces Genuin's default targeting and decisions on users to target using forwarded signals.

entities.name: Identity Matching
entities.description: Framework for resolving Genuin-supplied non-PII matching signals (hashed device IDs, UA, truncated IP, geo, contextual signals, fingerprints) to iHeart user IDs either directly via Triton/Beeswax or via a third-party identity partner pre-mapping.

entities.name: Genuin SDK
entities.description: Client-side SDK that collects contextual/device signals from Genuin Placement, sends ad requests to Triton TAP, fetches video from Genuin BCC, and stitches video and audio at impression time.

entities.name: Genuin BCC
entities.description: Genuin's brand-side video upload and post-serving engine where iHeart manages its video library and from which Genuin SDK fetches video creatives at runtime.

entities.name: Genuin Placement
entities.description: On-page Genuin-powered placement that initialises in viewport, collects contextual and device signals, and renders the sponsored takeover.

entities.name: Genuin Player
entities.description: Runtime player that stitches abstract video assets with programmatic audio assets at impression time.

entities.name: Sponsored Takeover
entities.description: Highest-impact session-level placement that converts a Genuin-powered publisher feed into a fully branded experience; video is served from iHeart's creative library on Genuin and audio is served programmatically via Beeswax/Triton TAP.

entities.name: Sponsored Post
entities.description: Ad format in scope for the Genuin x iHeart integration, alongside Sponsored Takeover and Programmatic Activation.

entities.name: Programmatic InFeed
entities.description: Programmatic in-feed ad format identified as the primary format for the initial launch of the iHeart integration.

entities.name: Web SDK
entities.description: Web tag/SDK variant generated by Genuin for iHeart to place on new publisher pages such as PMC to extend iHeart's network under Option A.

entities.name: Genuin Network
entities.description: Genuin's existing network of publisher inventory and brand partners (e.g., MCC, TED) used to deliver iHeart's offsite audience extension without new publisher contracts.

entities.name: Audience Extension
entities.description: Commercial concept of extending iHeart's audience reach via Genuin's publisher inventory, executed through either Option A (publisher network expansion) or Option B (offsite extension).

entities.name: iHeart Network Expansion
entities.description: Execution model where iHeart uses Genuin-generated Web SDK tags to independently onboard new publisher domains (e.g., PMC), signing its own publisher agreements and managing Ads.txt/Sellers.json.

entities.name: Offsite Audience Extension
entities.description: Execution model where Genuin delivers iHeart's audience extension across Genuin's existing brand-partner network via a session-level sponsored takeover, with no new publisher contracts required.

relationships.description: Triton TAP is iHeart's owned SSP that runs the programmatic auction for the integration.
Beeswax receives oRTB 2.x bid requests from Triton TAP and returns winning audio creatives back to it.
Genuin SDK sends ad requests with collected signals to Triton TAP and receives VAST tags in response.
Genuin SDK sends a video fetch request to Genuin BCC and renders the returned video creative.
Genuin SDK consumes the VAST tag returned by Triton TAP to play the winning audio creative.
Beeswax operates on oRTB 2.x bid requests packaged by Triton TAP.
Genuin SDK stitches video and audio client-side and renders the sponsored takeover in the placement.
The sponsored takeover relies on Triton TAP to run the audio auction and return VAST creative.
Beeswax provides the winning audio creative for the sponsored takeover.
Video creative for the sponsored takeover is served by Genuin BCC.
Genuin Player performs runtime stitching of abstract video and programmatic audio assets for the takeover.
The Web SDK tag is the web-delivery variant of the Genuin SDK stack used to onboard new publisher domains.
Genuin Placement initialises in viewport and feeds collected signals into Genuin SDK.
PMC (pmc.com) is given as the example new publisher domain onboarded under Option A.
MCC is an example publisher in the Genuin network used under Option B.
TED is an example publisher in the Genuin network used under Option B.
iHeart Network Expansion (Option A) is one of the two audience-extension execution models.
Offsite Audience Extension (Option B) is one of the two audience-extension execution models.
MCC is part of Genuin's existing brand-partner network.
TED is part of Genuin's existing brand-partner network.
UID 2.0 is the universal pseudonymous identifier operated by The Trade Desk.
LiveRamp is listed as a preferred third-party identity partner for programmatic audio resolution.
ID5 is listed as a privacy-first identity partner option for resolving Genuin signals.
Lotame (Panorama ID) is listed as an identity partner option for mid-market matching.
UID 2.0 is listed as a universal-ID identity partner option.
BYOA is the direct-sponsorship targeting mode within the identity-matching framework where iHeart's algorithm performs all decisioning on Genuin-forwarded signals.
Under Option A, iHeart signs direct commercial agreements with new publisher domains such as PMC.
iHeart relies on Beeswax to apply targeting and select winning audio creatives in programmatic execution.
iHeart uses its owned Triton TAP SSP to route demand and run the audio auction for the integration.
Programmatic InFeed is the primary in-feed format launching alongside the Sponsored Takeover placement family.
Sponsored Post is grouped with Sponsored Takeover and Programmatic Activation as the ad formats in scope for the integration.
